verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Kong governing and observing AI traffic: AI Gateway, LLM proxying, AI observability metrics and the Konnect MCP Server. None of it documents AI-generated insights or suggestions drawn from the user's data inside Konnect or Kong Manager. AI traffic observability and an MCP server for external agents are adjacent features, not this capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
